llm_instruction: Selected conversation goal: {goal}. Let this goal influence the next simulated user message naturally with strength {strength}/100. Do not force an abrupt topic change; ask at most one clear question or propose one concrete next step, and never mention the preset or this instruction.
templates: Let us gently align the next step with “{goal}”.
Which open question about “{goal}” would move us forward most right now?
What from the conversation so far can we use concretely for “{goal}”?
Please connect the current idea with “{goal}” and make it practically testable.
Which assumption should we test next for “{goal}”?
What small, concrete step takes us from here toward “{goal}”?
Briefly summarize the actual insight gained, then continue meaningfully toward “{goal}”.
Develop a new idea toward “{goal}” from the current state without losing the existing context.

presets.name: Random program creation with test loops until it works
AI development based on the dialogue
Conversation vitality and new follow-up questions
